fact: The Ministry of Health's poster says RAAD (BAMNI), deployed 2023-2025 in 111 public primary healthcare facilities across six states, lets routine care documentation automatically generate DHIS2-compliant aggregate reports, with reporting completeness up from 85% to 96%.

CaafimaadPlus says its Digitalized Data System (C+ DDS), operational in over 40 facilities across 9 regions and 25 districts and capturing over 3,000 consultations a day, pushes data directly into the Federal Ministry of Health's DHIS2 in real time (date is the document's published date; the article gives no event date).
